record.body:
## Description

R10: The area page lists each effort of the area as a row that links to `#/effort/<name>`.
R11: The area page shows the open ideas of the area in an Ideas section.
R15: The area page shows one Needs-you list that merges the items of the efforts in the area.
R16: Each Needs-you row on the area page names its effort.
R17: The area page has no Needs-you action buttons.
R31: Each Needs-you row on the area page links to its effort's page.

## Approach

Tests: write the test file named below. Start every test name with the requirement id and a space, for example `R5 an area card shows the open idea count`. Write one test for each requirement and no other test name starts with an id. Run the test first and see it fail on an assertion, then implement. File: `dashboard/frontend/src/lib/screens/areaPage.test.ts`.

1. New `src/lib/screens/EffortRow.svelte`: `<a class="effort-row" data-effort-row={name} href={effortHref(name)}>` with the effort name, kind, goal and the Needs-you count. No `<button>`.
2. Rewrite `src/lib/screens/Area.svelte` (keep `data-area-screen`, `data-area-scope`, `data-area-open`). Sections in order: scope; the rollup stats (`areaRollup`); `Needs you` (`data-area-needs`); `Efforts` (one `EffortRow` for each effort of the area); `Ideas` (open ideas only, `data-area-open`). Drop the Back button; the breadcrumb is the way up.
3. The `Needs you` list merges `needs_you` of all efforts in the area. Each row is an `<a data-area-need>` to `effortHref(effort)` that names its effort. Reuse the row fields that `NeedsRows.svelte` shows, but render no button and no `data-act`. The "Moved to effort" collapsible goes away; the next task adds "Started as efforts".
4. Replace the area screen tests (R7 to R10) in `src/lib/screens/areas.test.ts` with tests that match the new page; delete tests that the new `areaPage.test.ts` covers.

Run `npm run lint`, `npm run check` and `npm test` in `dashboard/frontend` before you finish. Do not add comments that explain a change.

payload.title: Area page with effort rows, ideas and a read-only Needs-you list
